unitTitle: A week in my life: connect the details
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 1: A week in my life: connect the details

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the main schedule first. Then notice how the speakers ask a follow-up question and check a detail instead of pretending they understood.

steps.title: A schedule that changed
steps.body: Nadia and Sam compare their work and French-study weeks.

examples.fr: D'habitude, je révise le mardi soir, mais cette semaine j'ai un atelier.
examples.en: Nadia: I usually review on Tuesday evening, but this week I have a workshop.

examples.fr: Tu as un atelier au travail ?
examples.en: Sam: Do you have a workshop at work?

examples.fr: Non, un atelier de français. Il commence à dix-huit heures.
examples.en: Nadia: No, a French workshop. It starts at six p.m.

examples.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, tu ne peux pas réviser mardi.
examples.en: Sam: If I understood correctly, you can't review Tuesday.

examples.fr: Oui, c'est ça. Je vais réviser mercredi parce que je suis libre.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, that's right. I am going to review Wednesday because I am free.

examples.fr: Et tu prends une pause quand ?
examples.en: Sam: And when do you take a break?

examples.fr: Je prends une pause après le travail, puis je me repose le soir.
examples.en: Nadia: I take a break after work, then I rest in the evening.

steps.title: Clarify the meeting time
steps.body: A learner checks a class schedule with a classmate.

examples.fr: On planifie notre séance de français. Tu es libre jeudi ?
examples.en: Sam: We are planning our French session. Are you free Thursday?

examples.fr: Oui, mais je termine le travail à dix-sept heures.
examples.en: Julie: Yes, but I finish work at five p.m.

examples.fr: Je veux dire jeudi à dix-huit heures.
examples.en: Sam: I mean Thursday at six p.m.

examples.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, la séance commence à dix-huit heures ?
examples.en: Julie: If I understood correctly, the session starts at six p.m.?

examples.fr: Oui. D'abord, on révise le français; ensuite, on parle de notre semaine.
examples.en: Sam: Yes. First, we review French; then we talk about our week.

examples.fr: D'accord. Je prends des notes et je prépare une question.
examples.en: Julie: Okay. I will take notes and prepare a question.

steps.prompt: Why does Nadia change her usual Tuesday review?
steps.explain: Nadia says she has a French workshop on Tuesday.
She says she will review on Wednesday because she is free.

steps.prompt: What time does Julie finish work on Thursday?
steps.explain: Julie says she finishes at seventeen hundred, or 5 p.m.

steps.prompt: What will Sam and Julie do first?
steps.explain: Sam says: D'abord, on révise le français.
